text:
Dr. Yara Lindqvist led the excavation at Tel Maridun, according to the Maridun Heritage Authority's Final Excavation Summary, which I read at the Authority's annual symposium in Valderra.

Tomas Adeyemi-Roth, site registrar for the Authority, confirmed her role when I asked him directly after the session. "Dr. Lindqvist was director of the dig from start to finish," he told me.

The summary states that the excavation's final season closed on 14 September 2019. Over the course of the project, the team recovered 1,284 catalogued artifacts across 11 trenches.

Copies of the summary were handed out to attendees at the symposium. Mr. Adeyemi-Roth said the registrar's office holds the full catalogue of finds for anyone wishing to consult it.

The Gazette will report further on the findings as more detail becomes available.
